about_the_game:
Mysterious deaths kept happening, and then suddenly, a suburban hospital shut down.

As a journalist, you step into the abandoned hospital to uncover the truth.

Scattered throughout the hospital are 10 medical records. Collect them and find your way out.

But there’s one problem… You’re a total coward.

The only way to run is to scream and force yourself forward.

Shout your way to the finish!

Game Features

🔊 Mic Input
Scream into your mic to run.
Running away from enemies by actually screaming makes the experience even more immersive.

(You can play without a mic, but you won’t be able to run, making the game much harder.)
(Normal movement is done with WASD.)

🌍 Online Multiplayer
Play with up to 4 players!
Scream together with your friends.

🎙 Proximity Voice Chat
Talk to your friends while playing.
If you hear a scream in the distance… run for your life!

Controls

  • Move: WASD

  • Run: Scream into your mic

  • Look Around: Mouse

  • Pick Up Items: Right Click

  • Use Flashlight: Left Click

  • Settings: Esc

Streaming & Content Creation

Feel free to stream and upload videos—no permission needed!
Just make sure to include the game title in your video and a link to this store page in the description.

We’re not responsible for any issues caused by playing or streaming this game.
This guideline may change without notice.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX1660

short_description: MustScream is an online co-op horror game for 1-4 players that uses mic input. Scream into your mic to run! Push your voice to the limit and make it to the end!
